summary.title: Flutter Master Class Travel App | Flutter 3.13.0 for Beginners to Advanced | iOS & Android Cubit
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a Flutter travel app step by step, covering carousel onboarding, bottom navigation, a custom TabBar indicator, a detail page, and Cubit state management with REST API calls.
keywords: build flutter app step by step
takeaways: How to build a PageView.builder carousel with dots and reusable text and button widgets
How to build bottom navigation, a styled TabBar with a custom indicator, and a TabBarView
How to make an HTTP REST API request with the http package and map the response to a model
How to manage app state with a Cubit: states, emit() for loading and loaded data, BlocProvider and BlocBuilder
How to navigate to a detail page and pass in dynamic data via Cubit
summary.summary: This is a long video tutorial (about 4 hours, per the chapter timeline) that builds a Flutter travel app for iOS and Android, targeting Flutter 3.13.0. It moves through a welcome carousel, a main page with bottom navigation, a home page with a custom-styled TabBar and TabBarView, and a detail page built with Stack and Positioned widgets. The later chapters add Cubit state management, the http package for a REST API call, a data model, and BlocBuilder to replace static data with loaded data. The page text is mostly the chapter list and video UI, so the specifics beyond the chapter titles are not visible.
